item.description: A woman living in Grayson is sharing her transplant story and urging people to become organ donors as thousands of people remain on the waitlist across Georgia.Monica Davis works as a therapist by day, but as she and her husband, Kweku Davis, grew their family, she said everything started to change."In 2010, I had twin daughters, and I was 42 years old," she said. item.title: Lanes blocked on I-285 by Covington Highway after tractor-trailer crash
item.description: All lanes are temporarily closed after a crash on Interstate 285 southbound in DeKalb County, transportation officials said Sunday morning.

item.title: Man charged in shooting outside closed Atlanta dental office
item.description: A 73-year-old man is facing charges after a deadly shooting outside a building in southwest Atlanta on Saturday afternoon. David Mays is accused of murder, aggravated assault, and possession of a firearm during the commission of a felony. Mays is booked at the Fulton County Jail.Atlanta police responded to a building in the 3400 block of Martin Luther King Drive SW around 3:05 p.m. on Saturday for a report of a person shot, authorities said. item.description: A 22-year-old man accused of trying to kick down the door at an Atlanta apartment while impersonating a police officer is now facing charges after being shot. item.title: Mattie's Call: Family concerned over Ellenwood man's disappearance
item.description: Clayton County police have issued a Mattie's Call for a man with a medical condition that requires ongoing care. Calvin Redding, 62, was last seen wearing a white shirt, white shorts, no shoes, and yellow hospital socks while leaving his home in the 5700 block of Springfield Place on Saturday in Ellenwood.Police said family members are concerned about Redding's well-being.He is about 5 feet 7 inches tall, with black hair and brown eyes. item.title: Car crashes into Atlanta dry cleaners causing partial building collapse
item.description: A car plowed through the side of a dry cleaning business in northeast Atlanta Sunday morning, causing parts of the building to crumble and overflow into the street. Fashionaid Dry Cleaners at 1433 Piedmont Avenue suffered a partial collapse after a vehicle crashed into the side of the building. A section of the roadway surrounding the business was blocked off around 10 a.m. while crews worked to clear debris from the collapse. item.title: Vulnerable adult: Peachtree City woman reported missing found safe
item.description: Peachtree City police found a 27-year-old woman classified as a vulnerable adult who was reported missing on Sunday. Gerann Thonica Grant was last seen shortly after midnight at the Wisdom Woods apartment complex, wearing a light brown jacket, police said.Grant is about 4 feet 10 inches tall, weighs 210 pounds, has short black hair, and hazel eyes.

item.title: Atlanta teen accused of shooting family member's boyfriend
item.description: A 17-year-old is facing charges after Atlanta police said he shot a family member’s boyfriend in the chest during a dispute on Saturday evening. Police responded to a home in the 200 block of Peyton Place SW around 6:15 p.m., where they found the victim with a gunshot wound in the chest. item.title: Atlanta native Jamal Lewis among ex-NFL players pardoned by Trump
item.description: Atlanta native and former NFL player Jamal Lewis was among five former players pardoned by President Donald Trump last week.

item.title: Atlanta police investigate deadly shooting on Coleman Street
item.description: Police are investigating a deadly shooting at a home in southwest Atlanta on Sunday afternoon. Police responded to a home in the 900 block of Coleman Street SW where they found a man who was fatally shot. Homicide detectives are investigating this case. Authorities did not provide any further details on what led to the shooting. Neighbors in the area called the shooting concerning.
